title: Three.js scene through a postprocessing EffectComposer, rendered once per seek
summary: Torus knot and orbs drawn by RenderPass, then one merged EffectPass with Bloom, Vignette and ChromaticAberration; 90 frames at 1280x720, shuffled order matches sequential, frame 30 alpha 0-255. No Noise or Glitch effects.
